answer: Lotus river vouchers: each lotus must hold three quartz vouchers from three river neighbours, on a rising curve: voucher j costs 2j+8 coins. The first fake pays 36, the tenth 198, the hundredth 1,818, so ten fakes cost 1,170 and a hundred 92,700. A voucher backs one lotus only and burns if its lotus is caught fake, so each extra fake pays more and clones cannot share vouchers.
